exact_source_preconditions: The same Alice WebSocket session first exercises the integration-room joins, destruction and recreation, then leaves that recreated room.
Alice creates integration-locked with id=locked-owner-join; tests owner/outsider disco and second-join denial.
Alice submits locked-cancel and waits for a frame containing locked-cancel, asserting type=result.
Bob sends post-cancel-create, asserts code=201 and affiliation=owner, submits post-cancel-instant, then leaves and waits for code=110.
Alice sends an untagged join presence to integration-controls@conference.localhost/Alice.

Alice calls receive_until("code=110") in the source spelling with single-quoted XML attributes; that helper returns the first WebSocket frame containing the marker, without checking room, stanza id, or stanza type.

The returned frame is then required to contain both creation code=201 and affiliation=owner. The assertion fails; available evidence does not reveal which required field was absent or the selected frame origin.
